title: Evaluating Prostate Cancer Patient Natural Killer Cell Function Across Racial Background and Addressing Functional Disparities With Trispecific Killer Engagers
official: Evaluating Prostate Cancer Patient Natural Killer Cell Function Across Racial Background and Addressing Functional Disparities With Trispecific Killer Engagers
summary: This study collects, stores and analyzes blood specimens and information from people with prostate cancer. This may help researchers understand whether certain white blood cells involved in immunity differs between prostate cancer patients from various racial backgrounds.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* AIM 1:

  * Diagnosis (or presumed diagnosis) of primary Prostate cancer
  * 18 years of age or older
  * Has a planned visit to a University of Minnesota Cancer Clinic
  * Willing and able to sign voluntary written consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* AIM 1:

  * Inability or unwillingness to give written informed consent
sponsor: Masonic Cancer Center, University of Minnesota
